title: 2022 Federal Election: House of Representatives final results
notes: Official final House of Representatives result. Labor won 77 seats; the Coalition won 58.

title: 2022 Election commitments report
notes: The PBO report records the budget impact of major-party election commitments against the 2022 PEFO baseline.

title: 2022 General Election: party commitment lists and costings
notes: The PBO publishes party-provided commitment lists and related election commitment costings.

title: 2022 ECR: Australian Labor Party
notes: PBO analysis of Labor commitments, including Cheaper Child Care, Housing Australia Future Fund and Rewiring the Nation.

title: Save more on Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme medicines
publisher: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
notes: Records that from 1 January 2023 the maximum price of most PBS medicines for non-concession patients fell from $42.50 to $30.

title: Lower medicine costs for chronic health conditions
publisher: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
notes: Records the first stage of 60-day dispensing for 92 PBS medicines from 1 September 2023.

title: 2022-23 October Budget: Housing Australia Future Fund
notes: Budget paper describing the Housing Australia Future Fund and its planned contribution to social and affordable housing.

title: Rewiring the Nation deal to fast-track clean energy jobs and security in NSW
publisher: Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
notes: Records a Commonwealth and NSW agreement involving $4.7 billion from the Commonwealth and $3.1 billion from the NSW Transmission Acceleration Facility.

title: Beyond the budget 2022-23: Fiscal outlook and scenarios
notes: PBO analysis states that 148 of Labor's 154 recorded commitments were explicitly reflected in the October 2022 budget measures, with modifications.

title: Reduce the maximum general PBS co-payment from $42.50 to $30
summary: A 2022 election commitment to reduce the maximum general patient co-payment for PBS medicines from 1 January 2023.

title: Expand 60-day dispensing for eligible medicines
summary: A commitment to make selected medicines cheaper by allowing eligible patients to receive two months of medicine for one prescription co-payment.

title: Create the Housing Australia Future Fund
summary: A commitment to establish a long-term funding mechanism for social and affordable housing, including 30,000 homes over five years in the budget formulation.

title: Invest in Rewiring the Nation
summary: A commitment to invest in transmission and renewable-energy infrastructure through a public financing vehicle and related agreements.

title: PBS general co-payment reduced on 1 January 2023
finding: The Department of Health records that the maximum price of most PBS medicines for non-concession patients fell from $42.50 to $30 from 1 January 2023.

title: First stage of 60-day dispensing began in September 2023
finding: The Department of Health records that eligible Australians could receive 92 PBS medicines at a lower cost under the first stage of 60-day dispensing from 1 September 2023. This supports implementation, but not necessarily completion of the full policy ambition.

title: Housing Australia Future Fund appears in the October 2022 budget
finding: The October 2022 budget paper describes the Housing Australia Future Fund and a planned contribution toward social and affordable homes. This confirms a funded policy measure, while delivery outcomes require later housing data.

title: Commonwealth and NSW Rewiring the Nation agreement announced
finding: The Energy Department records a December 2022 agreement involving $4.7 billion from the Commonwealth and $3.1 billion from the NSW Transmission Acceleration Facility. This is implementation evidence for the program, not proof that every promised network outcome has been delivered.
